description:
CLOSED as absorbed by fz-kdt.106 (a010532e8, 2026-09-01). The event
landed: budget_collapsed is a real public telemetry event (allowlisted,
readable from --log-telemetry, proven end-to-end by a budget=1 probe ->
75 event lines). The sink-shape question was answered BY MEASUREMENT
during the refuter fix round: the collapses fire in
ActivationInputAlternatives::join_assign/rebuild -- a JoinContribution
trait method whose only reachable handle is Ctx = Types -- NOT in
push_row (instrumented: 28/28 predicate collapses from join_assign,
zero from push_row), so the counter lives on Types
(activation_input_collapses + note/take), drained through
World::take_activation_input_collapses in the flush_reported_warnings
producer/drain shape at the World API boundary. No thread-local
survives. A first-class threaded sink would require growing
JoinContribution::Ctx into a GAT across all three implementors for no
measured benefit -- rejected. Baseline record: 3 of 449 dumping fixtures
collapsed at base (00420 x2 aliases at 30, predicate 28, 88 events
corpus-wide); zero at head; the engineered stress shape still collapses
3x (genuine correlation width, pinned by fz-zih's fixture when built).
title: The activation-input row budget needs a telemetry event: a collapse is the history-vs-input work signal
